item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00050","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C23","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14, issued only two days earlier, uses the same distinctive operative formula: suspending specified promotion-related legal provisions for identified military officers for the duration of the national emergency proclaimed on December 16, 1950. The child expands that machinery from professional examinations in the Army and Air Force medical corps to grade distribution, selection, temporary promotion, and discharge rules for Navy and Marine Corps officers, then adds exceptions. C23 is a clear older antecedent to C14 but uses a fixed expiration date and is less directly aligned with the child. C13 shares the emergency-based suspension setting but not the same personnel-promotion machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the operation of those provisions of Title III of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947, as amended, which relate to the distribution in grades, promotion by selection, temporary promotion, and discharge on second failure of selection for promotion ... are hereby suspended for the duration of the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950","parent_excerpt":"The operation of all provisions of law requiring professional examinations for promotion ... are hereby suspended for the duration of the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950.","explanation":"The directives share an unusually close suspension formula, the same promotion context, and the identical emergency-duration trigger."},{"child_excerpt":"officers of the grades of lieutenant, lieutenant (junior grade), and ensign of the Navy, and of corresponding grades of the Marine Corps","parent_excerpt":"officers of the Medical, Dental, and Veterinary Corps, and ... officers designated as medical, dental, and veterinary officers","explanation":"Both adapt the suspension provision by precisely identifying the affected officer classes and armed services."},{"child_excerpt":"Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 hereof","parent_excerpt":"The operation of all provisions of law requiring professional examinations for promotion ... are hereby suspended","explanation":"The child preserves C14's core suspension mechanism but develops it into a two-part order with transition exceptions for pending promotions and voluntary discharges."}]}
